verdict: Superbottoms has foundational schema but needs AI-optimized content structure
ai_summary: Shopify store with basic Organization schema. Lacks FAQ, Answer-Led Content, and Specificity Evidence needed for AI visibility.

categories.name: Entity Clarity
categories.finding: Organization schema present but minimal detail about brand mission
categories.fix: Expand schema with founder info, founding year, brand values

categories.name: Extractable Structure
categories.finding: Generic Shopify structure; no semantic grouping of product benefits
categories.fix: Add hierarchical content sections with clear H2/H3 tags

categories.name: Schema Markup
categories.finding: Has Organization, WebSite, MerchantReturnPolicy; missing Product, FAQ schemas
categories.fix: Add Product schema with full attributes, FAQPage schema

categories.name: FAQ Coverage
categories.finding: No FAQ schema detected; critical for AI Q&A indexing
categories.fix: Implement 8-10 FAQ items addressing parent concerns about safety

categories.name: Answer-Led Content
categories.finding: Content appears product-centric; lacks direct answer paragraphs
categories.fix: Add 'What is...', 'How to...', 'Why choose...' answer sections

categories.name: Specificity & Evidence
categories.finding: No certifications, third-party validation, or detailed product specs visible
categories.fix: Add certification badges, clinical studies, parent testimonials

Create Answer-Led sections: 'Why organic cotton diapers matter for babies'
